title: ProofOfVisitCheckRequest
description: Web service to agent service: Moderation in proof-only mode (spec 09). A Proof of Visit attached later to a published Testimony is read; the Testimony's text and photos are not sent and not screened again.

visitMonth.description: Stated visit month of the Testimony, YYYY-MM.

typedProviderName.description: The Listed Provider name (or the name the author typed).

googleDisplayName.description: Live Google display name fetched by the web service and held in memory only, for the Proof of Visit match. Never stored.

proofOfVisit.description: The private Proof of Visit, deleted by the web service after the decision unless an admin must look at it.
proofOfVisit.title: ProofOfVisitCheckDocument
